title: The US Courts, Kosmos, and Comedy.
content:
Venus, which Kosmos 842 failed to reach some 50 years ago The People v. Donald Trump, Surely This Donald Trump doesn't want to spend money authorized by the US Congress. Is that legal? If so, is it right in terms of the checks and balances on the executive branch? People are talking about it in this thread!

Duck, A Space Probe is Heading Home A 50 year old space probe intended for Venus never quite made it there. It's lingered in Earth orbit for five decades and is now due to come crashing back to Earth, literally.

A Comedy Goldmine Sick of scrolling endlessly for something funny to watch? No problem, AskMetafilter has a crowdsourced list of comedy movie recommendations. Real people recommending and sharing real favorites—no AI nonsense here baby!
